BackstoryDef.title: underground courier
BackstoryDef.description: Growing up in a settlement terrified of nocturnal kidnappings, [PAWN_nameDef] learned how to slip through ruined alleys unseen and pass coded messages between trusted neighbors. [PAWN_pronoun] developed a fierce hatred for tyranny and hidden oppressors.

BackstoryDef.title: railroad cell leader
BackstoryDef.description: Commanding the secretive Railroad from hidden catacombs, [PAWN_nameDef] coordinates daring rescues to smuggle fugitive synths to freedom. Guarded, chain-smoking, and fiercely principled, [PAWN_pronoun] sacrifices everything to keep the underground network alive.

BackstoryDef.title: smooth-talking drifter
BackstoryDef.description: Wandering between wasteland towns with little more than a sharp wit and a knack for tall tales, [PAWN_nameDef] learned early that blending in is better than standing out. [PAWN_pronoun] could talk [PAWN_possessive] way out of almost any tight corner.

BackstoryDef.title: master of disguise
BackstoryDef.description: Haunted by dark mistakes from [PAWN_possessive] youth, [PAWN_nameDef] joined the Railroad as its sharpest field spy and scout. Constantly changing outfits, faces, and cover stories, [PAWN_pronoun] hides deep loyalty behind endless lies and dry humor.

BackstoryDef.title: paranoid radio builder
BackstoryDef.description: Convinced from childhood that invisible signals and secret cabals were watching the wasteland, [PAWN_nameDef] spent [PAWN_possessive] days soldering salvaged circuit boards and decrypting static broadcasts. [PAWN_pronoun] trusted wires and gauges far more than people.

BackstoryDef.title: eccentric underground engineer
BackstoryDef.description: The Railroad's resident genius and chief conspiracy theorist, [PAWN_nameDef] builds ballistic-weave armor, tracking beacons, and experimental tech out of wasteland junk. Hyperactive and wildly eccentric, [PAWN_pronoun] backs up [PAWN_possessive] bizarre theories with brilliant inventions.

BackstoryDef.title: conditioned heavy unit
BackstoryDef.description: Trained in sterile underground facilities to serve without question, [PAWN_nameDef] was built for endurance, discipline, and heavy combat. Yet beneath rigid conditioning, [PAWN_pronoun] quietly yearned for freedom and a life of [PAWN_possessive] own.

BackstoryDef.title: railroad heavy operative
BackstoryDef.description: Escaping bondage with the help of the Railroad, [PAWN_nameDef] chose to keep [PAWN_possessive] memories intact and fight for others still trapped underground. Calm, fearless, and armed with a roaring minigun, [PAWN_pronoun] leads the faction's toughest strike missions.
